import numpy as np

def classifier_free_guidance(x_t, t, model, prompt_embed, scale=7.5):
    null_embed = np.zeros_like(prompt_embed)
    eps_cond = model(x_t, t, prompt_embed)
    eps_uncond = model(x_t, t, null_embed)
    eps_guided = eps_uncond + scale * (eps_cond - eps_uncond)
    return eps_guided
